key: The Ifiok team reviews every font. If it is approved, a one-off payment is added to your earnings.

key: Use only fonts you are allowed to share, such as open-source fonts or fonts licensed for templates. List every font you used when you submit. Keep the text editable so others can change the words.

ig: Anyị na-ele arịrịọ ahụ anya ma kwụọ ụgwọ site n'ịkwụ ego banki na akaụntụ gị e kwadoro.

key: We send your order updates and the code here.
fr: Nous envoyons ici les mises à jour de vos commandes et le code.
pcm: We go send your order updates and the code here.
yo: Níbí ni a ó ti fi ìròyìn àṣẹ rẹ àti kóòdù ránṣẹ́.
ha: Muna aiko muku sabbin bayanan odarku da lambar nan.
ig: Anyị na-ezipụ gị mmelite iwu gị na koodu ebe a.

fr: Nous avons envoyé un code à 6 chiffres au +234 {phone}. Saisissez-le ci-dessous.
pcm: We don send 6-digit code go +234 {phone}. Put am below.
yo: A fi kóòdù oní-nọ́ńbà mẹ́fà ránṣẹ́ sí +234 {phone}. Tẹ̀ ẹ́ sísàlẹ̀ yìí.
ha: Mun aika lamba mai lambobi 6 zuwa +234 {phone}. Shigar da ita a ƙasa.
ig: Anyị zigara koodu nke ọnụọgụ 6 na +234 {phone}. Tinye ya n'okpuru.

key: We will let you know here.
yo: A ó jẹ́ kí o mọ̀ níbí.
ha: Za mu sanar da kai a nan.

yo: Kí ni mo lè fi ránṣẹ́?
ig: Kedu ihe m nwere ike ibunye?

fr: Qu'est-ce qui l'a inspirée ? Où rend-elle le mieux ?
pcm: Wetin give you the idea? Where e go look best?
yo: Kí ló fún ọ ní ìmísí? Níbo ni ó ti dára jù?
ha: Me ya ƙarfafa shi? A ina ya fi kyau?
ig: Gịnị kpaliri ya? Ebe ọ na-adị mma kachasị?

ig: Gịnị ka ọ dị mma maka ya?

key: What reviewers look for. Reviews take {reviewTime}.
fr: Ce que les examinateurs recherchent. L'examen prend {reviewTime}.
pcm: Wetin reviewers dey look. Review dey take {reviewTime}.
yo: Ohun tí àwọn olùyẹ̀wò ń wá. Àyẹ̀wò máa ń gba {reviewTime}.
ha: Abin da masu dubawa ke nema. Dubawa na ɗaukar {reviewTime}.
ig: Ihe ndị nlele na-achọ. Nlele na-ewe {reviewTime}.

yo: Àwòrán kí ni o máa ṣe lónìí?
Kí ni o máa kọ́kọ́ ṣe?
ig: Gịnị ka ị ga-ebu ụzọ mee?

key: When the Ifiok team approves a template, a one-off payment for it is added to your available balance.
fr: Lorsque l'équipe Ifiok approuve un modèle, un paiement unique correspondant est ajouté à votre solde disponible.
pcm: When Ifiok team approve template, one-time payment for am go enter your available balance.
yo: Nígbà tí ẹgbẹ́ Ifiok bá fọwọ́ sí àwòṣe kan, a óò fi owó ìsanwó lẹ́ẹ̀kan fún un kún ìyókù owó rẹ tó wà.
ha: Idan ƙungiyar Ifiok ta amince da samfuri, ana ƙara biyan kuɗi na sau ɗaya a kansa cikin kuɗin da kake da shi.
ig: Mgbe ndị otu Ifiok kwenyere na template, a na-etinye ụgwọ otu ugboro maka ya na ego dị gị.

yo: Níbo ni kí a ti sanwó fún ọ?
ha: A ina za mu biya ka?
ig: Ebee ka anyị kwụọ gị ụgwọ?

yo: Ibi tí àwọn fáìlì rẹ wà
Ta ni ń fọwọ́ sí àwọn àwòṣe mi?
Ta ni lè béèrè fún un?

key: Work that copies another designer, a brand or a template from somewhere else.
fr: Travaux qui copient un autre designer, une marque ou un modèle venu d'ailleurs.
pcm: Work wey copy another designer, a brand or template from another place.
yo: Iṣẹ́ tí ó ń dà kọ oníṣẹ́ àwòrán míràn, ilé iṣẹ́ kan tàbí àwòṣe láti ibòmíràn.
ha: Aikin da ya kwafi wani mai zane, wata alama ko samfuri daga wani wuri.
ig: Ọrụ nke na-ṅomi onye ọzọ na-ese design, brand ma ọ bụ template si ebe ọzọ.

yo: Akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tí a ti fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀ ni ọ́
ha: Kai ɗalibi ne da aka tabbatar
ig: Ị bụ nwa akwụkwọ e kwenyere

ha: Ba ka da wani abu da ya rage.

key: You can add up to 6 files.
pcm: You fit add 6 files at most.
yo: O lè fi àwọn fáìlì tó tó 6 kún un.
ha: Za ka iya ƙara fayiloli har 6.
ig: Ị nwere ike itinye faịlụ ruo 6.

key: You can duplicate this template, rework it and submit it again.
fr: Vous pouvez dupliquer ce modèle, le retravailler et le soumettre à nouveau.
pcm: You fit duplicate this template, fix am well and submit am again.
yo: O lè ṣe ẹ̀dà àwòṣe yìí, tún un ṣe, kí o sì fi ránṣẹ́ lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.
ha: Za ka iya kwafar wannan samfuri, ka sake gyara shi, ka sake aikawa.
ig: Ị nwere ike iṅomi template a, megharịa ya ma bunyeghachi ya.

key: You can request a payout now.
fr: Vous pouvez demander un versement maintenant.
pcm: You fit ask for payout now.
yo: O lè béèrè fún ìsanwó báyìí.
ha: Za ka iya neman biyan kuɗi yanzu.
ig: Ị nwere ike ịrịọ ịkwụ ụgwọ ugbu a.

key: You made it yourself, and the fonts, photos and icons in it are ones you may use.
fr: Vous l'avez créé vous-même, et les polices, photos et icônes utilisées sont libres d'usage pour vous.
pcm: You make am yourself, and the fonts, photos and icons wey dey inside na ones wey you fit use.
yo: Ìwọ fúnra rẹ ni o ṣe é, àwọn fọ́ńtì, fọ́tò àti aami inú rẹ̀ sì jẹ́ èyí tí o lè lò.
ha: Kai da kanka ka yi shi, kuma font, hotuna da alamun da ke ciki an yarda ka yi amfani da su.
ig: Ị mere ya n'onwe gị, ma font, foto na icon dị na ya bụ ndị ị nwere ike iji.

key: You need {amount} available to request a payout.
fr: Vous devez avoir {amount} disponibles pour demander un versement.
pcm: You need {amount} available before you fit ask for payout.
yo: O nílò {amount} láti béèrè fún ìsanwó.
ha: Kana buƙatar {amount} a hannunka don neman biyan kuɗi.
ig: Ị chọrọ {amount} dị iji rịọ ịkwụ ụgwọ.

key: Your earnings and payments. Only you can see this page.
fr: Vos gains et paiements. Vous seul voyez cette page.
pcm: Your earnings and payments. Only you fit see this page.
yo: Owó tí o rí àti àwọn ìsanwó rẹ. Ìwọ nìkan ló lè rí ojú-ìwé yìí.
ha: Kuɗin shigarka da biyan kuɗinka. Kai kaɗai za ka iya ganin wannan shafi.
ig: Ego ị rụpụtara na ịkwụ ụgwọ gị. Naanị gị nwere ike ịhụ ibe a.

key: Your payouts appear on your creator dashboard when you sign in. You add your payout details there after you are approved, so the application never asks for a bank account.
fr: Vos versements apparaissent sur votre tableau de bord créateur à la connexion. Vous y ajoutez vos informations de versement après votre approbation : la candidature ne demande jamais de compte bancaire.
pcm: Your payouts go show for your creator dashboard when you sign in. You go add your payout details there after dem approve you, so the application no dey ask for bank account.
yo: Àwọn ìsanwó rẹ máa hàn lórí pátákó olùṣẹ̀dá rẹ nígbà tí o bá wọlé. Níbẹ̀ ni wàá ti fi àlàyé ìsanwó rẹ kún un lẹ́yìn tí a bá fọwọ́ sí ọ, nítorí náà fọ́ọ̀mù ìbéèrè kì í béèrè fún àkáǹtì báńkì.
ha: Biyan kuɗinka na bayyana a dashbod ɗin mai ƙirƙira idan ka shiga. Za ka ƙara bayanan biyan kuɗinka a can bayan an amince da kai, don haka neman shiga ba ya tambayar asusun banki.
ig: Ịkwụ ụgwọ gị na-apụta na dashboard onye okike gị mgbe ị banyere. Ị na-etinye nkọwa ịkwụ ụgwọ gị n'ebe ahụ mgbe e kwenyechara gị, ya mere ngwa ahụ anaghị ajụ akaụntụ banki.

key: Your photos, logos and PDFs, ready to drop into any design.
fr: Vos photos, logos et PDF, prêts à être glissés dans n'importe quel design.
pcm: Your photos, logos and PDFs, ready to put for any design.
yo: Àwọn fọ́tò, lògó àti PDF rẹ, ṣetán láti fi sínú àwòrán èyíkéyìí.
ha: Hotunanka, tambura da PDF ɗinka, a shirye don sanyawa a kowane zane.
ig: Foto, logo na PDF gị, dị njikere itinye n’ime design ọ bụla.

key: Your profile, delivery addresses and payment preferences.
fr: Votre profil, adresses de livraison et préférences de paiement.
pcm: Your profile, delivery addresses and how you want pay.
yo: Pírófáìlì rẹ, àdírẹ́sì ìfijíṣẹ́ àti ètò ìsanwó.
ha: Bayananka, adiresoshin isarwa da zaɓin biyan kuɗi.
ig: Profaịlụ gị, adreesị nnyefe na ụzọ ịkwụ ụgwọ masịrị gị.

key: Your student ID is being checked
fr: Votre carte d'étudiant est en cours de vérification
pcm: We dey check your student ID
yo: À ń yẹ káàdì ìdánimọ̀ akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ rẹ wò
ig: A na-elele ID nwa akwụkwọ gị

key: Your student perks are on. Make something for class today.
fr: Vos avantages étudiants sont activés. Créez quelque chose pour vos cours aujourd'hui.
pcm: Your student perks don open. Make something for class today.
yo: Àwọn àǹfààní akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ rẹ ti ṣí. Ṣe nǹkan kan fún kíláàsì lónìí.
ha: Fa’idodin ɗalibinka sun buɗe. Ƙirƙiri wani abu don aji yau.
ig: Uru nwa akwụkwọ gị emeghere. Mepụta ihe maka klaasị taa.
